title: A focus ring must keep 3:1 against the tint its own focus or selection puts behind it
rule: When a row or container takes a tint on hover, on focus-within or when selected, and a control inside it uses the global accent ring, check the ring's contrast against the composited tint in both themes, not only against the flat surfaces. A surface that just reaches 3:1 falls under it with any tint. Draw the ring round the tinted element, on the plain surface, and add a Playwright check of the computed outline on the element that carries it, for the plain and the selected row.
rationale: E41.3 (#449): the accent ring of a sidebar label sat on the row's hover and 7 % tints at 2.43:1 to 2.76:1, and contrast.test.ts checked the ring on flat surfaces only.
